## Description

Integrates recurrent neural networks with multivariate Hawkes point processes to forecast optimal execution timing windows by predicting bursty order book liquidity refills.

## Where it may fit

Institutional block trade execution, minimizing market impact during liquidity dry-ups.

## Vehicles

Agency Execution Desks, Algorithmic Execution Brokers, Institutional Asset Managers.

## Required data

Millisecond limit order book level 2/3 message streams, historical volume profiles, trade timestamps.

## Caveats

Recurrent Hawkes intensity updates require low-latency C++/GPU execution engines.
